analyst.summary: AGL is the newly demerged international freight-forwarding arm of the Allcargo group, built around ECU Worldwide, the world's largest LCL consolidator. Its first year of reported numbers shows a loss driven mainly by one-off and industry-wide shipping disruptions rather than a breakdown in its core business, but as a standalone listing barely a month old it does not yet have the track record to judge with confidence. We recommend Hold pending more standalone data.
